description: Create temp doc, add text frame, read text contents, cleanup
source: var d = app.documents.add(); try { var tf = d.textFrames.add(); tf.contents = 'hello minify'; return {count: d.textFrames.length, contents: tf.contents, k: tf.kind}; } finally { try { d.close(SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES); } catch(e){} }
